sentences.text: A newspaper is a serial publication containing news about current events , other informative articles about politics , sports , arts , and so on , and advertising .	news	news	articles	article (publishing)	advertising	advertising	sports	sports journalism
A newspaper is usually , but not exclusively , printed on relatively inexpensive , low-grade paper such as newsprint .	paper	paper	newsprint	newsprint
The journalism organizations that publish newspapers are themselves often metonymically called newspapers .	journalism	journalism	metonymically	metonymy
As of 2017 , most newspapers are now published online as well as in print .	published online	electronic publishing	in print	printing
The online versions are called online newspapers or news websites .	news	news
Newspapers are typically published daily or weekly .	daily	newspaper#Daily	weekly	weekly newspaper
News magazines are also weekly , but they have a magazine format .	weekly	weekly newspaper	magazine	magazine

General-interest newspapers typically publish news articles and feature articles on national and international news as well as local news .	news	news	articles	article (publishing)	news articles	article (publishing)#News articles	feature articles	feature story	local news	local news

The news includes political events and personalities , business and finance , crime , weather , and natural disasters ; health and medicine , science , and computers and technology ; sports ; and entertainment , society , food and cooking , clothing and home fashion , and the arts .	news	news	political events and personalities	political journalism	business and finance	business journalism	health and medicine	medical journalism	science	science journalism	sports	sports journalism	entertainment	entertainment journalism	society	society reporting	the arts	the arts	food	food column

Usually the paper is divided into sections for each of those major groupings -LRB- labeled A , B , C , and so on , with pagination prefixes yielding page numbers A1-A20 , B1-B20 , C1-C20 , and so on -RRB- .	paper	paper

Most traditional papers also feature an editorial page containing editorials written by an editor -LRB- or by the paper 's editorial board -RRB- and expressing an opinion on a public issue , opinion articles called `` op-eds '' written by guest writers -LRB- which are typically in the same section as the editorial -RRB- , and columns that express the personal opinions of columnists , usually offering analysis and synthesis that attempts to translate the raw data of the news into information telling the reader `` what it all means '' and persuading them to concur .	news	news	articles	article (publishing)	paper	paper	editorial	editorial	columns	column (periodical)	data	data
Papers also include articles which have no byline ; these articles are written by staff writers .	articles	article (publishing)	byline	byline
A wide variety of material has been published in newspapers .

Besides the aforementioned news , information and opinions , they include weather forecasts ; criticism and reviews of the arts -LRB- including literature , film , television , theater , fine arts , and architecture -RRB- and of local services such as restaurants ; obituaries , birth notices and graduation announcements ; entertainment features such as crosswords , horoscopes , editorial cartoons , gag cartoons , and comic strips ; advice columns , food , and other columns ; and radio and television listings -LRB- program schedules -RRB- .	news	news	entertainment	entertainment journalism	the arts	the arts	editorial	editorial	columns	column (periodical)	literature	literature	film	film	television	television	theater	theater	fine arts	fine arts	architecture	architecture	obituaries	obituary	advice	advice column	food	food column
As of 2017 , newspapers may also provide information about new movies and TV shows available on streaming video services like Netflix .	streaming video	streaming video	Netflix	Netflix

Newspapers have classified ad sections where people and businesses can buy small advertisements to sell goods or services ; as of 2013 , the huge increase in Internet websites for selling goods , such as Craigslist and eBay has led to significantly less classified ad sales for newspapers .	classified ad	classified ad	Internet	Internet	Craigslist	Craigslist	eBay	eBay

Most newspapers are businesses , and they pay their expenses with a mixture of subscription revenue , newsstand sales , and advertising revenue -LRB- other businesses or individuals pay to place advertisements in the pages , including display ads , classified ads , and their online equivalents -RRB- .	advertising	advertising	subscription	Subscription business model	newsstand sales	newsagent's shop	display ads	newspaper display advertising	classified ads	classified advertising	their online equivalents	online advertising
Some newspapers are government-run or at least government-funded ; their reliance on advertising revenue and on profitability is less critical to their survival .	advertising	advertising

The editorial independence of a newspaper is thus always subject to the interest of someone , whether owners , advertisers , or a government .	editorial	editorial	editorial independence	editorial independence

Some newspapers with high editorial independence , high journalism quality , and large circulation are viewed as newspapers of record .	journalism	journalism	editorial	editorial	editorial independence	editorial independence	newspapers of record	newspaper of record

Many newspapers , besides employing journalists on their own payrolls , also subscribe to news agencies -LRB- wire services -RRB- -LRB- such as the Associated Press , Reuters , or Agence France-Presse -RRB- , which employ journalists to find , assemble , and report the news , then sell the content to the various newspapers .	news	news	news agencies	news agency	Associated Press	Associated Press	Reuters	Reuters	Agence France-Presse	Agence France-Presse	content	content (media)
This is a way to avoid duplicating the expense of reporting from around the world .

Circa 2005 , there were approximately 6,580 daily newspaper titles in the world selling 395 million print copies a day -LRB- in the U.S. , 1,450 titles selling 55 million copies -RRB- .	daily	newspaper#Daily

The late 2000s -- early 2010s global recession , combined with the rapid growth of free web-based alternatives , has helped cause a decline in advertising and circulation , as many papers had to retrench operations to stanch the losses .	advertising	advertising	web	World Wide Web
Worldwide annual revenue approached $ 100 billion in 2005-7 , then plunged during the worldwide financial crisis of 2008-9 .
Revenue in 2016 fell to only $ 53 billion , hurting every major publisher as their efforts to gain online income fell far short of the goal .

The decline in advertising revenues affected both the print and online media as well as all other mediums ; print advertising was once lucrative but has greatly declined , and the prices of online advertising are often lower than those of their print precursors .	advertising	advertising	online advertising	online advertising

Besides remodeling advertising , the internet -LRB- especially the web -RRB- has also challenged the business models of the print-only era by crowdsourcing both publishing in general -LRB- sharing information with others -RRB- and , more specifically , journalism -LRB- the work of finding , assembling , and reporting the news -RRB- .	news	news	advertising	advertising	journalism	journalism	web	World Wide Web	crowdsourcing	crowdsourcing

In addition , the rise of news aggregators , which bundle linked articles from many online newspapers and other sources , influences the flow of web traffic .	news	news	articles	article (publishing)	web	World Wide Web	web traffic	web traffic
Increasing paywalling of online newspapers may be counteracting those effects .
The oldest newspaper still published is the Ordinari Post Tijdender , which was established in Stockholm in 1645 .	Ordinari Post Tijdender	Ordinari Post Tijdender	Stockholm	Stockholm
